questions.text: Captain is to ship as pilot is to ___ → ___
questions.explanation: A captain commands a ship; a pilot commands a plane.

questions.text: What comes next: ZA, YB, XC, WD, ___ → ___
questions.explanation: First letter counts down from Z; second counts up from A.

questions.text: Complete the analogy: Hot : Cold :: Wet : ___ → ___
questions.explanation: Hot and Cold are opposites. Wet and Dry are opposites.

questions.text: Add a letter to the start and end of ATE to make a new word → ___
questions.explanation: Adding G and D: G+ATE+D = GATED. RATED(R+ATE+D), HATED, FATED also valid.

questions.text: What comes next: A, E, I, M, ___ → ___
questions.explanation: +4 each time: A+4=E, E+4=I, I+4=M, M+4=Q.

questions.text: What comes next: spring, summer, autumn, ___ → ___
questions.explanation: The four seasons in order.

questions.text: What is the missing pair: Z1, Y2, X3, ?, V5 → ___
questions.explanation: Letters count down from Z; numbers count up: W=4th from Z? Z,Y,X,W → W4.

questions.text: Mendel is to genetics as Newton is to ___ → ___
questions.explanation: Mendel pioneered genetics; Newton is famous for gravity/physics.

questions.text: What word can follow BUTTER and precede FLY → ___
questions.explanation: BUTTERCUP ✓ (a flower), CUPFLY? No. Actually: BUTTER+FLY = BUTTERFLY. The word in the middle of BUTTER_FLY is nothing needed. But for BUTTER (___) FLY: BUTTERCUP/CUPFLY? The answer the question seeks is the word that follows BUTTER to make BUTTERFLY directly = no middle word needed for that.

questions.text: What comes next: AAB, BBC, CCD, DDE, ___ → ___
questions.explanation: Each group: two same letters + next letter. D,D,E → E,E,F.

questions.text: Complete the analogy: Knife : Surgeon :: Pen : ___ → ___
questions.explanation: A knife is the main tool of a surgeon; a pen is the main tool of a writer.

questions.text: If yesterday was two days after Monday, what day is tomorrow → ___
questions.explanation: Two days after Monday = Wednesday = yesterday. Today = Thursday. Tomorrow = Friday.

questions.text: A shape reflected in a vertical mirror: arrow pointing right becomes ___
questions.explanation: A vertical mirror flips left and right.

questions.text: Code: A=triangle, B=square, C=circle. 1=small, 2=medium, 3=large. What is B2?
questions.explanation: B=square, 2=medium → medium square.

questions.text: Which 3D shape is the odd one out? Cube, cuboid, sphere, cylinder
questions.explanation: Cube, cuboid, cylinder all have flat faces. A sphere has no flat faces.

questions.text: A shape is moved 2 squares right and 1 square up. It started at (3,2). New position is ___
In a 3×3 matrix: row 1 = circles, row 2 = squares, row 3 = triangles. Column 1 = small, column 2 = medium, column 3 = large. What is in position row 3, column 2?
questions.explanation: Row 3 = triangle, column 2 = medium → medium triangle.

questions.text: A rectangle is folded in half lengthways. A cut is made parallel to the fold halfway along. Unfolded, the paper becomes ___
options: one piece cut at one end
questions.explanation: Cutting through both layers parallel to the fold separates the paper into two pieces.

questions.text: In a matrix, the pattern in each row is: shape rotates 90° CW each column. Row 1 starts with arrow →. Row 1, column 3 shows ___
Shape with shading on the left half: reflected in vertical axis → shading is on ___
questions.explanation: Vertical reflection swaps left and right.

questions.text: Sequence rule: number of internal dots = number of sides². A square (4 sides) has ___ dots.
questions.explanation: 4² = 16 dots.

questions.text: Arrow sequence: →, ↓, ←, ↑, ___
questions.explanation: Rotating 90° clockwise: after ↑ comes → (full rotation complete).

questions.text: Which 3D shape has exactly 1 vertex (apex)?
questions.explanation: A cone has exactly 1 vertex at its apex.

questions.text: Shape at (4,4) reflected in the line x=3. New x-coordinate is ___
questions.explanation: Distance from x=3 is 1. Reflected: 3-1=2.

questions.text: A triangular prism has how many faces?
questions.explanation: 2 triangular ends + 3 rectangular sides = 5 faces.

questions.text: Odd one out: cone, pyramid, prism, sphere — based on having a circular cross-section
questions.explanation: Cone, prism (circular), sphere all have curved surfaces. A pyramid has only flat triangular faces.

questions.text: Which shape has the most diagonals? Square, pentagon, hexagon, octagon
questions.explanation: Number of diagonals = n(n-3)/2. Octagon: 8×5/2=20 — the most.

questions.text: Paper is folded once. A semicircle cut from the folded edge creates what shape when unfolded?
questions.explanation: Cutting a semicircle from the fold creates a full circle when unfolded.

questions.text: In a sequence, the figure rotates 45° clockwise each step and gains one dot. Step 1: 1 dot, 0°. Step 5: ___ dots, ___ degrees
What is the missing shape? Large black square, large white square, small black square, ___
questions.explanation: Pattern: large black, large white, small black, small white.

questions.text: How many degrees is a quarter turn?
questions.explanation: A quarter of 360° = 90°.

questions.text: Which shape has exactly 2 lines of symmetry?
questions.explanation: A non-square rectangle has exactly 2 lines of symmetry.

questions.text: Shape belongs to Set A if: it has 4 sides AND is white. Set B if: it has 3 sides AND is black. Small black triangle belongs to ___
questions.explanation: 3 sides ✓ AND black ✓ → Set B.

questions.text: A shape reflected in a horizontal mirror: arrow pointing up becomes ___
questions.explanation: A horizontal mirror flips up and down.

questions.text: Each term: shape gains one more side. Also, shading alternates black/white. Term 5 is a hexagon. What colour is it?
questions.explanation: If term 1 is white: white, black, white, black, white... Term 5 = white? Depends on start. If term 1 black: term 5 = black. Standard: alternating starting black = term 5 black.

questions.text: If shape A has 4 sides and 4 right angles, and shape B has 4 sides with 2 pairs of equal opposite angles, what is shape B?
questions.explanation: A rhombus has 4 equal sides with 2 pairs of equal opposite angles.

questions.text: Shape rotated 90° clockwise: top becomes ___, right becomes ___
questions.explanation: 90° CW: top→right, right→bottom, bottom→left, left→top.

questions.text: True or False: The answer to [In a matrix, the pattern in each row is: shape rotates 90° CW each column. Row 1 starts with arrow →. Row 1, column 3 shows ___] is: →.
True or False: The answer to [A grid has shapes rotating 90° clockwise each step. Step 1: arrow pointing right. Step 3: arrow pointing ___] is: right.
questions.explanation: 90° clockwise: right→down→left. Step 3 = left.

questions.text: True or False: The answer to [A right-angled triangle with the right angle at bottom-left: reflected vertically, the right angle is now at ___] is: bottom-right.
questions.explanation: Vertical reflection: left↔right. Bottom-left becomes bottom-right.

questions.text: True or False: The answer to [A diagonal line going from bottom-left to top-right: reflected in a horizontal axis becomes ___] is: same diagonal.
questions.explanation: Horizontal reflection flips up/down: bottom-left→top-left, top-right→bottom-right.

questions.text: True or False: The answer to [A tetrahedron is made of how many triangular faces] is: 3.
questions.explanation: A tetrahedron has 4 equilateral triangular faces.

questions.text: True or False: The answer to [Odd one out in terms of rotational symmetry order: equilateral triangle, square, regular hexagon, scalene triangle] is: Scalene triangle.
questions.explanation: Equilateral(3), square(4), hexagon(6) all have rotational symmetry >1. Scalene triangle has order 1.

questions.text: True or False: The answer to [Triangle is to 3 as octagon is to ___] is: 6.
questions.explanation: Triangle has 3 sides; octagon has 8 sides.

questions.text: True or False: The answer to [Pattern: 1 dot, 3 dots, 6 dots, 10 dots, ___] is: 15.
questions.explanation: Triangle numbers: +2,+3,+4,+5: 10+5=15.

questions.text: True or False: The answer to [Which 3D shape is the odd one out? Cube, cuboid, sphere, cylinder] is: Sphere.
questions.explanation: Cube, cuboid, cylinder all have flat faces. A sphere has no flat faces.

questions.text: True or False: The answer to [A flag has a star in the top-left. After 180° rotation, the star is in the ___] is: bottom-right.
questions.explanation: 180° rotation: top-left→bottom-right.

questions.text: True or False: The answer to [A shape has rotational symmetry of order 4. It could be a ___] is: square.
questions.explanation: A square looks the same after rotations of 90°, 180°, 270°, 360° = order 4.

questions.text: True or False: The answer to [Shape has a white triangle in the top-left. After reflection in the line y=x (diagonal), the triangle is in the ___] is: top-left.
questions.explanation: Reflection in y=x swaps x and y coordinates. Top-left(0,1)→top-right(1,0)? Actually (col,row): top-left→bottom-left... Diagonal reflection: (x,y)→(y,x). Top-left corner stays at top-left, but the triangle moves to top-right.

questions.text: True or False: The answer to [In a 3×3 matrix: row 1 = circles, row 2 = squares, row 3 = triangles. Column 1 = small, column 2 = medium, column 3 = large. What is in position row 3, column 2] is: medium triangle.
questions.explanation: Row 3 = triangle, column 2 = medium → medium triangle.

questions.text: True or False: The answer to [Shape A has 1 black dot in the top-right. After 180° rotation, the dot is in the ___] is: top-right.
questions.explanation: 180° rotation moves top-right to bottom-left.

questions.text: True or False: The answer to [Pattern: shapes alternate between inside a circle (A) and outside (B). Item 6 is ___] is: A.
questions.explanation: A,B,A,B,A,B — item 6 = B.

questions.text: True or False: The answer to [Matrix: each row contains shapes with 3, 4 and 5 sides in some order. Row 2 has square and pentagon. Missing shape has ___] is: 4 sides.
questions.explanation: Missing 3-sided shape = triangle.

questions.text: True or False: The answer to [A letter b reflected in a horizontal axis becomes ___] is: p.
questions.explanation: Reflecting b over a horizontal axis flips it to p.

questions.text: True or False: The answer to [A square pyramid has how many faces] is: 4.
questions.explanation: 1 square base + 4 triangular sides = 5 faces.

questions.text: True or False: The answer to [A square is folded in half twice (horizontally then vertically), then punched once. Unfolded, how many holes] is: 2.
questions.explanation: 2 folds = 4 layers. One punch = 4 holes.

questions.text: True or False: The answer to [A cube has how many faces] is: 6.
questions.explanation: A cube has 6 square faces.

questions.text: True or False: The answer to [A shape is moved 2 squares right and 1 square up. It started at (3,2). New position is ___] is: (1,3).
True or False: The answer to [A shape has 5 lines of symmetry. It must be a ___] is: square.
questions.explanation: A regular pentagon has exactly 5 lines of symmetry.

questions.text: True or False: The answer to [Shape code: large black circle = LBC, small white square = SWS. What is large white circle] is: LWC.
questions.explanation: L=large, W=white, C=circle → LWC.

questions.text: True or False: The answer to [If shape A has 4 sides and 4 right angles, and shape B has 4 sides with 2 pairs of equal opposite angles, what is shape B] is: Square.
questions.explanation: A rhombus has 4 equal sides with 2 pairs of equal opposite angles.

questions.text: True or False: The answer to [A rectangle is folded in half lengthways. A cut is made parallel to the fold halfway along. Unfolded, the paper becomes ___] is: two separate pieces.
questions.explanation: Cutting through both layers parallel to the fold separates the paper into two pieces.

questions.text: Odd one out: shapes with 4 lines of symmetry only. Square, Rectangle, Rhombus, Circle → ___
questions.explanation: Square, rectangle, rhombus have exactly 4 or 2 lines of symmetry. Circle has infinite.

questions.text: Shape code: XY where X=size (S=small, L=large) and Y=shape (T,C,S for triangle, circle, square). What shape is LC → ___
questions.explanation: L=large, C=circle → large circle.

questions.text: How many lines of symmetry does a regular hexagon have → ___
questions.explanation: A regular hexagon has 6 lines of symmetry.

questions.text: A cube net is laid flat. The face marked X is the base. Which face is the top when folded → ___
questions.explanation: In a cube, opposite faces face each other. The top is always opposite the base.

questions.text: A diagonal line going from bottom-left to top-right: reflected in a horizontal axis becomes ___ → ___
questions.explanation: Horizontal reflection flips up/down: bottom-left→top-left, top-right→bottom-right.

questions.text: Which shape has the most diagonals? Square, pentagon, hexagon, octagon → ___
questions.explanation: Number of diagonals = n(n-3)/2. Octagon: 8×5/2=20 — the most.

questions.text: Which 3D shape is the odd one out? Cube, cuboid, sphere, cylinder → ___
questions.explanation: Cube, cuboid, cylinder all have flat faces. A sphere has no flat faces.

questions.text: How many vertices does a cube have → ___
questions.explanation: A cube has 8 corners (vertices).

questions.text: Paper is folded once. A semicircle cut from the folded edge creates what shape when unfolded → ___
questions.explanation: Cutting a semicircle from the fold creates a full circle when unfolded.

questions.text: A letter R rotated 180° looks most like ___ → ___
questions.explanation: Rotating R 180° produces an upside-down R.

questions.text: A 3×3 grid: top row = 1,2,3 dots. Middle row = 4,5,6 dots. Bottom-right cell should have ___ → ___
questions.explanation: Counting pattern 1 to 9 across the grid.

questions.text: Pattern: shapes alternate between inside a circle (A) and outside (B). Item 6 is ___ → ___
questions.explanation: A,B,A,B,A,B — item 6 = B.

questions.text: Which net would NOT fold to make a cube? A) T-shape of 6 squares B) Z-shape of 6 squares C) 1×6 strip of squares D) Cross shape of 6 squares → ___
questions.explanation: A straight 1×6 strip cannot fold into a cube — opposite faces cannot align correctly.

questions.text: In a matrix, the pattern in each row is: shape rotates 90° CW each column. Row 1 starts with arrow →. Row 1, column 3 shows ___ → ___
Black circle inside white square : white circle inside black square :: black triangle inside white circle : ___ → ___
questions.explanation: Colours of inner and outer shapes swap.

questions.text: Matrix rule: each shape in each row/column appears exactly once. Row 1: circle, square, ?. Which shape is missing → ___
questions.explanation: Like a Sudoku: each shape appears once per row/column. Missing = triangle.

questions.text: Which 3D shape has exactly 1 vertex (apex) → ___
questions.explanation: A cone has exactly 1 vertex at its apex.

questions.text: Shape A has 1 black dot in the top-right. After 180° rotation, the dot is in the ___ → ___
questions.explanation: 180° rotation moves top-right to bottom-left.

questions.text: An arrow pointing East is rotated 270° clockwise. It now points ___ → ___
questions.explanation: 270° CW = 90° anticlockwise from East = North.

questions.text: A shape is moved 2 squares right and 1 square up. It started at (3,2). New position is ___ → ___
An arrow pointing North is rotated 90° clockwise. It now points ___ → ___
questions.explanation: 90° clockwise from North = East.

questions.text: A 3×3 grid: each row sums to the same total. Row 1: 2,3,4. Row 2: 1,4,4. Row 3: ?,2,5. Missing number is ___ → ___
Shape rule: each term gains one extra side. Triangle, square, pentagon, ___ → ___
questions.explanation: 3,4,5 sides. Next = 6 = hexagon.

questions.text: The number 3 reflected in a vertical axis looks most like ___ → ___
questions.explanation: A vertical reflection of 3 creates a backwards/mirrored 3.

questions.text: A square is folded in half, then folded in half again (same direction). What fraction of the original is each layer → ___
questions.explanation: Two folds in same direction = 4 layers, each 1/4 of original.
